name: Honjou Yuzuki
source:
Born into a prestigious family with a vast land, Yuzuki is a proud and headstrong young lady

She is a member of both the drama and tennis clubs, so she lacks a leading role; nevertheless, she's seen as a de-facto leader to the other students.
Her beauty, resourcefullnes, and confidence have earned her the admiration from many of her classmates, and word of her prestige extends to other schools.

Yuzuki is averse to men and is instantly scorfunul of the protaganist.
She has keen intuiton and keeps a watchful eye on the main character's movement.

She has an immense fear of male genitalia, or phallic objects in general due to childhood trauma. Despite this, they also make her feel very aroused.
